answer: An AI-agent market for garden supplies, from quartz gravel to umber paint, can enforce quadratic entry burns: identity k must destroy 2k−1 scarce tokens. The protocol assigns each key a fresh serial from a permanent global counter. A farm creating n aliases burns at least n² tokens; its next costs at least 2n+1. Splitting wallets cannot change that counter, deletion cannot rewind it, and pre-aging aliases requires paying every burn upfront.
